text:
seema: Quick sync — proposing a minimal onboarding flow that gates models fast but gives richer async signals. Idea: immediate "ingest-smoke" (<=4m) + deferred "full-horizon" (<=2h). Smoke should be deterministic and cheap. Full-horizon can be sampled+fuzzed.

rahul: Sounds reasonable. For smoke I want: 1) handshake validation (vocab id, max_len, dtype claims), 2) tokenization parity check (token count diff + first/last token ids), 3) a KV warmup pass with small prefix to validate cache shape.

seema: Agreed. Also require adapters to include `adapter_metadata` at registration. Minimal keys: `schema_version`, `vocab_digest`, `max_seq`, `kv_supported`, `preferred_batch`. If absent -> reject. We'll be strict for smoke.

tess: On full-horizon, capture three payload buckets: short (<32 tok), med (128-512), long (>1024). Run quality probes vs golden outputs and a cheap similarity metric (cosine of sentence embeddings) for regressions. Also run p50/p95 latency and cost estimates.

rahul: For sampling, propose: core deterministic set (our canonical golden set) + seeded fuzz N=30 per bucket. That surfaces edge cases while keeping reproducible records. Also include a batch-size KV shape test: same prefix across batch sizes [1,4,16] to catch padding/kv transpose bugs.

seema: UX: intake API should return a compact `ingest_result` object: smoke:{status, reasons}, horizon:{queued/complete, link}, actions:[]. Keep messages actionable (e.g., "vocab mismatch: expected sha256:X got sha256:Y").

tess: Threshold ideas (initial): tokenization parity >= 97% pass, 90-97% warn, <90% fail. Latency p95 <= 3x reference -> pass, 3-5x warn, >5x fail. Quality similarity >0.78 pass, 0.65-0.78 warn, <0.65 fail. These are placeholders; RFC will refine.

bench-bot: AUTO: queued full-horizon for model 'delta-test' (mid: m-774). ETA ~110m; posting results to #eng-ml/bench-results when done.

rahul: One more ops note: smoke must be idempotent and safe to run multiple times during retries. Avoid stateful writes in the path. Any write-back should be asynchronous after horizon completes.

seema: Implementation tasks: rahul -> smoke checklist CLI + KV warmup script (due Tue), tess -> horizon sampling harness + golden set curate (due Thu), me -> adapter_metadata schema PR and intake API shape (due Wed). I'll draft a short RFC update after these PRs land.

rahul: I'll mock the failure payload shapes for common errors. Example messages in smoke: `vocab_mismatch`, `kv_shape_error`, `handshake_missing_field`.

tess: If bench-bot flags a fail on horizon, we create a per-model follow-up thread and include the compact JSON plus recommended remediations.

seema: Thanks — sounds like a plan. We'll keep thresholds conservative and iterate. :thumbsup:
